create_WanControlModelSpecification: create a WanControlModelSpecification instance for Wan2.1 video generation with custom model paths and dtypes
load_condition_models: load tokenizer and text encoder models for Wan control specification from pretrained weights
load_latent_models: load VAE latent model for Wan control specification from pretrained weights
load_diffusion_models: load transformer and scheduler diffusion models with expanded input channels for Wan control
prepare_latents: prepare video latents and control latents with normalization for Wan control model inference
run_validation: run validation generation with control image or video conditioning using Wan pipeline
save_lora_weights: save LoRA transformer weights and norm state dict as safetensors to a directory
normalize_latents: normalize video latents using precomputed mean and standard deviation tensors
